## Body

**Security: block** at `a7a0f4a470532ae54d0103528b2bf338abff3bfe`.

S156001: the exported "dialog first line" can be arbitrary captured work content rather than trusted dialog chrome.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | 🟡 MEDIUM | crates/harnesses/src/modal.rs | 126-128, 147-151, 169-170 | Cropped dialog matching exports arbitrary model/work text into persisted stalls, messages and roster projections | 10/10 |

Copilot's anchored footer does not validate the exported title. `region_top` uses the row after the nearest opening rule, or row zero if that rule is no longer visible. `first_line` only trims and truncates that arbitrary row to 160 characters. The footer branch runs before the title branch.

A cropped dialog can therefore retain its recognized footer while starting with confidential model/work text. The committed lynx fixture begins with work-content table text and is accepted; the untitled test explicitly accepts a replacement non-title line (`crates/harnesses/src/modal.rs:253`).

Production copies this value into the stall record (`crates/daemon/src/modal_stall.rs:105`), persists it in `modal_stalls`, and places it in parent and PA/prime notifications, their `message.pushed` events, and `watchdog.modal-stall`. Roster/state projections, including shared cards, expose it too. Rendered private content can thus reach other seats' model contexts and authenticated roster readers, including paired-machine clients. The 160-character cap is not a privacy boundary.

Return a fixed marker-derived label, or require a recognized title inside a verified dialog block. Never substitute row zero or arbitrary body text when the title boundary is missing. Add a synthetic canary-content regression that preserves detection while proving the canary appears in no persisted stall, event, notification or projection.

**Other boundaries:** no whole-pane persistence, send or successful-capture logging found. Remaining capture text stays in memory. Quoted-above-composer fixtures are rejected; OMP/Pi are excluded before capture. Claims commit before telling, incoming deliveries do not count as own activity, and same-stretch claims suppress restart repeats. Those controls do not repair the exported-title boundary.

No automatic dialog-clearing key is sent to the stalled pane. Notification messages have `command: None`; clearing keys are descriptive. Existing guarded message delivery may type an ordinary notification into a recipient, so this is not a claim of "no typing anywhere."

**Public hygiene:** no separate C19/C21 disclosure finding in the 34 PR-owned changed files. Detected own-layout paths, loopback test URLs, product references and generic scratch fixtures are permitted. Confidential provenance was not independently certified.

**Proof:** CI [42381309337](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42381309337) passed all four jobs; its tested synthetic merge has the frozen head's tree. JUnit lists 2,089 passing cases, including all 11 relevant modal tests. Existing tests prove detection/notification/restart paths but explicitly allow unsafe non-title selection. The ddocs step reports UNAVAILABLE, not document validation. Source and CI review only; no local builds/tests, exploit execution, credential reads, live-pane operations, deployment or product edits.
